complete_primary_applications.exact_application: Multiply both source forms and dd^c by1/(2pi); do not change scalar V. The local matrix applies to arbitrary smooth invariant V at finite x; special endpoint behavior is used only to extend the constructed family. Check semipositive determinants without dividing by the vertical coefficient, giving12A Delta with actual normalized radial and Haar densities. Heat probability/Fourier differentiation gives the full stated Lemma3.1 claims. Lemmas3.2--3.3 apply uniformly at all the displayed eta,kappa,mu,t and, where chi>0, at kappa chi^2 with its matching sigma. The zero-chi region is handled directly. The new heat scale, integrated correction with nonzero limit, depth estimates, single infinite measure and critical capacity sequence are new proof obligations, not a use of the old final Proposition4.1 at its different scale.

complete_primary_applications.source: Bedford--Taylor, A new capacity for plurisubharmonic functions, Acta Math149(1982)
complete_primary_applications.exact_application: The source dd^c=2i partial barpartial equals4pi times the present operator; positive rescaling preserves the qualitative claims and changes only local product/capacity constants. All product arguments use genuinely locally bounded psh functions after a fixed quadratic correction. Positive closed symmetric multilinear mixed products and decreasing continuity justify compactly supported mixed-degree telescoping. Every lower mixed degree is dominated by a normalized bounded psh top cube including Euclidean quadratics. Quasi-continuity and compact decreasing-capacity continuity are applied on bounded coordinate balls; analytic pole sets have zero outer capacity there. Both global/local comparisons must be separately proved by genuine test gluing. The nonclosed coefficient gamma is a smooth test coefficient and is never assumed closed. Continuous depth weights require uniform bounded-depth capacity domination and continuous extension off small-capacity open sets. No global unbounded Hopf convergence theorem is imported.

complete_primary_applications.source: Demailly, Complex Analytic and Differential Geometry,I.4.17,I.5.4,I.5.8--5.9
complete_primary_applications.exact_application: Uniform compact connected chart submean bounds ensure the decreasing sum has finite L1 mass, so its corrected psh limit is not identically minus infinity. The decreasing limit and distributional current use the same genuine canonical representative and retain the3omega/4 current margin. No arbitrary upper modifications, mass bound or BMP is used. Standard compactness statements are permitted foundations with their exact local hypotheses; the source-read record is not a proof of every inherited foundational theorem.

indexed_final_applications.statement: On the scalar Hopf threefold, with dd^c_src=i∂bar∂ and omega_src=i∂bar∂s+i∂s∧bar∂s, s=log|z|², set xi=z'/z0, w=log z0, x=log|xi|² and mu=e^x/(1+e^x). For smooth real V(x,w), its local Hermitian matrix in the alpha_src-unit tangential, alpha_src-unit radial and ∂/∂w frame is [[(mu+V_x)/mu,0,0],[0,(mu+V_xx)/(mu(1-mu)),(mu+V_xbarw)/sqrt(mu(1-mu))],[0,(mu+V_wx)/sqrt(mu(1-mu)),1+V_wbarw]]. If V is independent of x for sufficiently negative x and constant in x,w for sufficiently positive x, it extends smoothly globally; positivity at xi=0 is equivalent to 1+V_wbarw>0. Xia–Zhang, Lemma 2.2.

For smooth real V(x,w), its local Hermitian matrix in the alpha_src-unit tangential, alpha_src-unit radial and partial/partial w frame is [[(mu+V_x)/mu,0,0],[0,(mu+V_xx)/(mu(1-mu)),(mu+V_xbarw)/sqrt(mu(1-mu))],[0,(mu+V_wx)/sqrt(mu(1-mu)),1+V_wbarw]]. If V is independent of x for sufficiently negative x and constant in x,w for sufficiently positive x, it extends smoothly globally; positivity at xi=0 is equivalent to 1+V_wbarw>0.
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed local Xia--Zhang matrix and the constructed-family endpoint extension match the full actual grant. Both forms and dd^c are divided by2pi; the arbitrary smooth invariant flux argument uses only the finite-x matrix and separately proves base-function endpoint slopes.

For fixed nonnegative integers a,m and t≥1, ||∂_t^aF_eta(t,·)||_C^m≤C_a,m eta exp(-t/4), uniformly in eta. Xia–Zhang, Lemma 3.1.

indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed heat identities and large-time estimate match the full actual grant, with probability Haar area, all t>0 and t>=1 scopes separated. The annulus and faster scale are proved directly, not granted.

indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed Gaussian and square bounds match the complete uniform parameter grant. Kappa chi^2 is used only where chi>0 with its matching sigma, and chi=0 is handled directly. The correction, core mass and new heat time remain proof obligations.

indexed_final_applications.statement: For an open Omega⊂C^n and locally bounded genuine psh functions p1,...,pk, 1≤k≤n, their Bedford–Taylor mixed product is a positive closed current, local and symmetric multilinear in its arguments, and weakly continuous under simultaneous decreasing locally bounded psh limits whose limits are locally bounded. Bedford–Taylor, Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.2.
indexed_final_applications.quote: For Omega contained in C^n and locally bounded genuine psh p1,...,pk, k<=n, their Bedford--Taylor mixed product is a positive closed current, local and symmetric multilinear in its arguments, and weakly continuous under simultaneous decreasing locally bounded psh limits.
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed bounded mixed Bedford--Taylor product matches the actual local grant; every argument has a fixed quadratic correction to a genuine locally bounded psh function, and decreasing limits used here remain locally bounded.

indexed_final_applications.statement: For locally bounded psh p,q on an open Omega⊂C^n, compactly supported smooth (n-k,n-k)-forms phi, and 1≤k≤n, ∫phi[(dd^c p)^k-(dd^c q)^k]=Σ_(l=0)^(k-1)∫(p-q)dd^c phi∧(dd^c p)^l∧(dd^c q)^(k-1-l). Bedford–Taylor, Corollary 2.8 and its mixed-degree integration-by-parts consequence.
indexed_final_applications.quote: For locally bounded psh p,q on Omega contained in C^n and compactly supported smooth (n-k,n-k)-forms phi,1<=k<=n, int phi[(dd^c p)^k-(dd^c q)^k]=sum_(l=0)^(k-1) int(p-q)dd^c phi wedge(dd^c p)^l wedge(dd^c q)^(k-1-l).
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed mixed-degree integration-by-parts identity matches its exact grant. Test coefficients are compactly supported and smooth, and powers of the possibly nonclosed gamma remain inside the test form.

indexed_final_applications.statement: For K compactly contained in an open Omega⊂C^n, bounded psh p1,...,pk with 1≤k≤n, and the Euclidean Kähler form beta, ∫_K dd^c p1∧...∧dd^c pk∧beta^(n-k)≤C_(K,Omega,k)Π_i||pi||_L∞(Omega). Bedford–Taylor, Theorem 2.10.
indexed_final_applications.quote: For K compactly contained in Omega contained in C^n, bounded psh p1,...,pk,k<=n, and the Euclidean Kahler form beta, int_K dd^c p1 wedge...wedge dd^c pk wedge beta^(n-k)<=C_(K,Omega,k) product_i ||pi||_L^infinity(Omega).
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed CLN statement matches its complete grant. The full printed source statement was read; its cited proof is not claimed printed in that passage or recursively certified. Normalized mixed top cubes and Euclidean factors give the needed local capacity domination.

indexed_final_applications.statement: On a bounded domain Omega⊂C^n, every genuine psh function is quasi-continuous for relative Bedford–Taylor capacity: for each epsilon>0 there is an open O⊂Omega with C(O,Omega)<epsilon such that the function restricted to Omega\O is continuous. Bedford–Taylor, Theorem 3.5.
indexed_final_applications.quote: On a bounded domain Omega contained in C^n, every genuine psh function is quasi-continuous for relative Bedford--Taylor capacity: for each epsilon>0 there is an open O contained in Omega with C(O,Omega)<epsilon such that its restriction to Omega minus O is continuous.
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed quasi-continuity theorem matches its actual bounded-domain grant. Only locally corrected genuine psh functions on the declared balls are used; global transfer is separately proved by both capacity comparisons.

indexed_final_applications.statement: On a bounded strongly pseudoconvex domain Omega⊂C^n, every locally pluripolar set has zero outer Bedford–Taylor capacity. Bedford–Taylor, Theorem 6.9.
indexed_final_applications.quote: On a bounded strongly pseudoconvex domain Omega contained in C^n, every locally pluripolar set has zero outer Bedford--Taylor capacity.
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed locally pluripolar zero outer capacity theorem matches its strongly pseudoconvex local grant. The pole hyperplane and local holomorphic zero section are analytic and lie in finite coordinate ball covers.

indexed_final_applications.statement: On a bounded strongly pseudoconvex domain Omega⊂C^n, if compact subsets K_j decrease to K, then C(K_j,Omega) decreases to C(K,Omega); also C*(K,Omega)=C(K,Omega). Bedford–Taylor, Proposition 6.4.
indexed_final_applications.quote: On a bounded strongly pseudoconvex Omega contained in C^n, if compact subsets K_j decrease to K, then C(K_j,Omega) decreases to C(K,Omega); also C*(K,Omega)=C(K,Omega).
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed decreasing compact capacity theorem and compact outer-capacity equality match the full actual grant. Closed compact neighborhoods shrink to the declared analytic set; both global/local capacity comparisons supply the global conclusion.

indexed_final_applications.statement: On an open Omega⊂C^n, a decreasing sequence of genuine psh functions has a genuine locally integrable psh pointwise limit whenever the limit is not identically -∞ on any component. A distribution with positive complex Hessian has a unique locally integrable genuine psh representative. The cone Psh(Omega)∩L1_loc(Omega) is closed in L1_loc(Omega), and its L1_loc-bounded subsets are relatively compact. Demailly, Complex Analytic and Differential Geometry, I.4.17, I.5.4 and I.5.8–5.9.
indexed_final_applications.quote: On an open Omega contained in C^n, a decreasing sequence of genuine psh functions has a genuine locally integrable psh pointwise limit whenever the limit is not identically minus infinity on any component. A distribution with positive complex Hessian has a unique locally integrable genuine psh representative. The cone Psh(Omega) intersect L1_loc(Omega) is closed in L1_loc, and its L1_loc-bounded subsets are relatively compact.
indexed_final_applications.root_logical_application: The indexed canonical psh decreasing-limit and distribution/L1 compactness statement matches its actual grant. Finite connected chart submean propagation proves the relevant uniform L1 bound and excludes identically minus infinity components; no mass bound or arbitrary upper modification is assumed.
